cover.subtitle: Jazz Festival
cover.venue: Museum of Science's Public Science Common
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Endea Owens is one of the most exciting voices in the next generation of jazz—a musician who plays with the full weight of the tradition and the freedom of someone with a lot left to say. NPR Music

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: -- 41 of 57 -- Bandleader, bassist, and composer Endea Owens draws from a vibrant community of New York jazz musicians who bring soul jazz warmth and irresistible hard bop grooves to every show—a band that offers everyone a seat at the table and a feast for the soul.
body: You're invited to share an exuberant, high-energy concert experience when Endea Owens & The Cookout make their Vivo Performing Arts debut. Bandleader, bassist, and composer Owens draws from a vibrant community of New York jazz musicians who bring soul jazz warmth and irresistible hard bop grooves to every show. Born from Owens' nonprofit work nurturing community through music and shared meals, The Cookout is a band that offers everyone a seat at the table and a feast for the soul.
